answer: The strongest single control I know for this is residence permit proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 754 aliases would need 754 separate proofs, each costing about 92 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The ivory of the design is public, the oasis of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the harbor of honest work is what finally pays. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
